description: Metasequoia IME (MSIME), a free and open-source Chinese input method for Windows built on TSF.
##: scoop update runs the uninstaller hook of the old manifest before installing the new version (scoop-update.ps1), and the vendor uninstaller deletes the user data directory, so the uninstaller hook returns early when Scoop's $cmd is 'update'.
notes: The setup registers a TSF input method for all users, so installing and uninstalling both need administrator rights and raise a UAC prompt.
This package only wraps the official setup: program files go to %ProgramFiles%\metasequoiaime and the TSF DLLs to %SystemRoot%\System32%\IME\MetasequoiaIME, outside the Scoop apps directory.

User data (settings, learned words, skins) is kept in %LOCALAPPDATA%\metasequoiaime. 'scoop update' keeps it by skipping the vendor uninstaller, while a real 'scoop uninstall' runs that uninstaller, which deletes the directory.
The vendor uninstaller leaves the input method in the Windows language list after removing its files; delete it under Settings > Time & language > Language & region if Win+Space still lists it.
The setup is Authenticode-signed by 'Open Source Developer LU FAN' (SignPath Foundation); Scoop only verifies the SHA256, so check the signature if you need that guarantee too.
The x64 Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable is required; without it the server exits and the input method cannot be turned on.
Press Win+Space to switch to the input method after installing.

script: if (!$setup) { abort 'The Metasequoia IME setup was not downloaded.' }
$exitCodes = @{ 3010 = 'A restart is required to finish the installation.' }

if (!(Invoke-ExternalCommand -FilePath $setup.FullName -ArgumentList '/VERYSILENT', '/SUPPRESSMSGBOXES', '/NORESTART', '/SP-' -Activity 'Running the Metasequoia IME setup' -RunAs -ContinueExitCodes $exitCodes)) { abort 'The Metasequoia IME setup failed.' }
Write-Host 'Skipping the vendor uninstaller during update: it would delete %LOCALAPPDATA%\metasequoiaime.'
$exitCodes = @{ 3010 = 'A restart is required to finish the uninstallation.' }

if ($uninstaller -and !(Invoke-ExternalCommand -FilePath $uninstaller.FullName -ArgumentList '/VERYSILENT', '/SUPPRESSMSGBOXES', '/NORESTART' -Activity 'Running the Metasequoia IME uninstaller' -RunAs -ContinueExitCodes $exitCodes)) { abort 'The Metasequoia IME uninstaller failed.' }
